text.p: These are significant stories in the Nigerian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Federal government to launch economic plan for next 15-20 years.
- Government rekindles hopes of creation of new states to supplement the 30 already in existence.
- Commonwealth has yet to decide on whether to visit Nigeria.
- New military governor of Lagos state freezes accounts until financial position left by his predecessor is made clear.
- Insurance industry may face bad debts of 2.5 billion naira as a result of granting cover on credit.
